name: Montage Deer Valley
insider_take: This ski-in, ski-out luxury resort sits at the base of Empire Canyon, where Utah's famous powder meets world-class hospitality in an exclusive mountain enclave.
whats_special: Montage Deer Valley is positioned on one of only three mountains in the world that restricts snowboarding, ensuring pristine groomed runs. The resort features direct access to Empire Canyon Lodge and sits within Deer Valley's members-only area, offering unparalleled exclusivity. The property's alpine architecture incorporates locally-sourced materials and the hotel maintains Utah's largest ski concierge team.
pro_tip: Book the hotel's complimentary Cadillac Escalade service to Park City Main Street - it's the most luxurious way to explore the historic mining town's galleries and restaurants without dealing with winter parking.
dont_miss: The rooftop Daly's Pub & Rec offers Utah's highest elevation pool with heated year-round swimming and mountain views. Try the signature "Deer Valley Martini" made with local High West whiskey, and experience the hotel's exclusive ski butlers who will carry your equipment and provide slope-side refreshments.
pros: Ski-in/ski-out access to Deer Valley Resort's pristine slopes
Luxurious alpine-inspired suites with full kitchens and mountain views
World-class Spa Montage with alpine-inspired treatments
Multiple dining venues including fine dining and casual mountain fare
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury mountain resort positioning
Seasonal availability with peak rates during ski season
